posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

It also stuck out to me as it's the only time we see Biomancer in card art that before the VotM release.

This could be for a few reasons (all are speculative and not to be taken as fact):

  1. Adam had more cool/important scenes he wanted to draw and just never found good spots for Biomancer in the coming expansions after initial release

  2. They were not sure for a long time where and how to impliment the character (Vengence? Mini nemesis card somewhere? Full Villain deck? ect.) and so the character was in creative game limbo for a bit, reflected in an art absence.

  3. Biomancer really isn't a major villain like the others even with a full apperance in VotM. Maybe he only has one major story/apperance outside of his ties with Scholar. Scholar never had his own book or series as far as I know, so his main nemesis probably didn't get a lot of screen time as well. You could pair this with #1 nicely
